about.title: About Xndzor
body: Xndzor brings together plot management, future harvest pre-sales, the market, and farm tools in one place.
Our goal is to answer “What should I grow?” using demand signals, group buying, and local market data.
The platform is built for real village farming in Armenia — offline deals, WhatsApp contact, and online payments for TOP/Pro packages.

help.title: Help
body: To post a listing, tap Add in the top menu or open the relevant section (machinery, animals, sell).
For TOP listings and Farm Pro, go to Pricing — payment is via Stripe (card).
In Grow Exchange you see demand signals by crop and region.
For other questions, write to us via Contact.

contact.title: Contact us
body: Email us or reach us on Telegram (official channel coming soon).
For business and media inquiries, mention Xndzor.com in the subject.
Technical support — describe the issue, attach a screenshot and listing link.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.lede: By using the platform you agree to these rules.
body: Xndzor.com is a marketplace — deal money is between parties; the platform only charges TOP/Pro/Verified fees.
Listings must be honest, without fraud or legally banned products.
We may remove or restrict accounts that break the rules.
Payment services (Stripe and future local wallets) have their own terms.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lede: What data we collect and how we use it.
body: At registration we store email, name, and listing data.
Payments are processed by Stripe — card data is not stored on our servers.
Cookies are used for login sessions and language preference.
You may request account deletion or corrections via Contact.

security.title: Security
security.introBody: Xndzor.com takes user security seriously. We protect your data with modern technology and help you trade safely in the agricultural marketplace.

tips.title: Protect your account
items: Use a strong, unique password — at least 10 characters with letters and numbers.
Never share your password with anyone.
Change your password regularly, especially after suspicious login attempts.
After failed logins your account is temporarily locked (8 attempts / 15 minutes).

tips.title: Safe meetings
items: Meet only in public places — markets, cafés, village centers.
Tell friends or family where you are going and when you expect to return.
Trust your intuition — if something feels wrong, walk away.
For farm deals and equipment viewings, bring someone with you when possible.

tips.title: Safe payments
items: Never send money in advance to strangers.
Use Stripe / platform checkout for TOP and Pro packages.
Inspect the product, animal, or machinery before you pay.
Avoid unknown wallets and unsafe transfer methods.
Prefer sellers verified through Farm Passport.

tips.title: Beware of scams
items: Be wary of offers that are too good to be true.
Check the seller's Farm Score, passport, and listing history.
Do not trust phone-only “verification” without a platform profile.
Report suspicious listings with the Report button or via Contact.

tips.title: Personal data
items: Share only the information needed for the deal.
Do not send bank details or card numbers in chat.
Use platform contact details and WhatsApp from the listing.
Watch for phishing — Xndzor.com will never ask for your password by email.

tips.title: Report violations
items: Report suspicious, fake, or illegal listings.
Use the Report listing button on the listing page.
Contact support immediately for serious violations.
Help keep the community safe — your report matters.

dataProtection.title: Data protection
body: The site uses a secure connection (HTTPS) — your information is sent in encrypted form.
Passwords are stored in scrambled form — we cannot see your actual password.
Login information is protected so other websites cannot misuse it.
Card payments go through Stripe's secure checkout page — we never store your card number.
We do not share your personal data with others without your permission.

cta.title: Have a problem?
cta.body: If you encountered a scam, suspicious listing, or technical issue — contact us right away.
cta.mailBody:
Hello,

I would like to report a security issue on Xndzor.com.

[describe the issue]

---

solve.title: Describe the need — get one complete offer
solve.lede: Write what you need in one sentence. Xndzor assembles workers, equipment, a truck, and a buyer into a single package — no days of phone chasing.
whatBody: Problem → solution is an Xndzor exclusive: you describe the farm need — harvest, tractor, workers, transport, or a buyer — and the platform builds one combined offer instead of ten separate listings.
In Armenia, this format — from one problem to a full solution — exists only on Xndzor. You are not left alone coordinating; the system connects suppliers and shows a clear package.
whyBody: Every day farmers spend hours on calls, WhatsApp, and “who has a tractor?” messages. One harvest often needs 3–4 different people — each found separately.
On Xndzor one post replaces that scramble: you see one offer, one timeline, one clear path. You save time, stress, and rush-hire premiums.

steps.title: Write the problem
steps.body: Example: “4 ha apples, harvest in 10 days” or “need a tractor and a truck.” Short and concrete is enough.

steps.title: Xndzor gathers the pieces
steps.body: The system looks for workers, equipment, transport, and/or a buyer in your marz and timeframe.

steps.title: You get one package
steps.body: In a single offer you see what the solution includes — without ten separate negotiations.

steps.title: Confirm and continue
steps.body: Pick what fits, connect with participants, and get to work with a clear plan.

advantages.title: One step, full solution
advantages.body: You don’t post four listings — one need becomes a combined offer.

advantages.title: Save days
advantages.body: What alone can take 2–3 days of calls is often organized much faster.

advantages.title: Fewer overpays
advantages.body: Rush rentals are expensive; an early, organized package is often cheaper.

advantages.title: Only on Xndzor
advantages.body: This problem-to-solution format is available in Armenia only here.

advantages.title: Works for every farm
advantages.body: Same simple logic for a small orchard or a large field.

faq.a: Not required. Start with one need (e.g. only a tractor); the system can suggest extra pieces if useful.
Core use is available through Xndzor. Any plan limits are listed on the pricing page.

faq.a: Write as you speak — simple Armenian (or your locale). Crop, area, and timing matter most.

faq.q: How is this different from a normal listing?

route.title: One truck — multiple farms, shared route
route.lede: Hauling alone is expensive. Xndzor Route pools neighboring farms’ crops on one optimal route — cost is split among participants.
whatBody: Xndzor Route is shared delivery: one truck picks up from several farms (e.g. Armavir → Artashat → Yerevan) and goes to a common destination.
In Armenia, this kind of shared farm route in this format exists only on Xndzor. You don’t pay for the whole truck alone.
whyBody: If every farm hires a truck alone, each pays nearly the full trip — even with a half-empty load.
On a shared route the truck fills from several farms, kilometers and fuel are split, and you save money and time with one agreed schedule.

grow.title: What to plant — know the market first
grow.lede: Grow Exchange shows demand and supply on one screen — overproduction warnings and clear signals on what to plant so the harvest sells.
whatBody: Grow Exchange is a national signal board for farmers: see which crops are in demand, where the market is full, and where overproduction risk is high.
In Armenia, this Grow Exchange format — seeing the market before planting — exists only on Xndzor. You don’t plant “like last year” with no new data.
whyBody: The wrong crop is a season lost — seed, labor, water, and time. When everyone plants the same thing, price collapses and crop stays in the field.
Grow helps you decide before you spend: if tomatoes in Ararat are already saturated, pick another crop or market — and avoid hundreds of thousands of AMD in losses.

whyBody: Buyers pay more willingly when they see origin and trust. Without identity you compete only on price — often by cutting it.
A strong Score and QR passport shorten negotiation: buyers doubt less, decide faster, and you can keep a fairer price.
